schema:
CREATE TABLE documents (
    pmid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT, doi TEXT, source TEXT, retrieved_at TEXT,
    has_fulltext INTEGER DEFAULT 0, raw_path TEXT,
    article_type TEXT, quality_type_prior TEXT,
    abstract_excerpt TEXT, created_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE chunks (
    chunk_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    pmid TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(pmid) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    ordinal INTEGER, heading_path TEXT, section_importance REAL DEFAULT 1.0,
    text TEXT, snippet TEXT, snippet_source TEXT,
    char_start INTEGER, char_end INTEGER, created_at TEXT
, level INTEGER DEFAULT 0, path TEXT, parent_id TEXT, child_ids TEXT, sibling_ids TEXT, heading_chain TEXT, doc_id TEXT)

CREATE TABLE relevance (
    chunk_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES chunks(chunk_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    query TEXT, chunk_relevance REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
    heading_match INTEGER DEFAULT 0, jaccard REAL DEFAULT 0.0, computed_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE quality_evidence (
    pmid TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES documents(pmid) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    criterion_validity REAL, outcome_reliability REAL,
    conclusion_data_consistency REAL, evidence_mean REAL, quality_final REAL,
    computed_at TEXT, notes TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE venue (
    pmid TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES documents(pmid) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    journal TEXT, year INTEGER, impact_factor REAL,
    jcr_quartile TEXT, cas_zone TEXT, source TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE document_groups (
    pmid TEXT NOT NULL, project_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT DEFAULT 'core', added_at TEXT, notes TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (pmid, project_slug)
)

CREATE TABLE projects (
    slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, status TEXT,
    description TEXT, created_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE project_queries (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    project_slug TEXT NOT NULL, query TEXT,
    pmid_count INTEGER, executed_at TEXT
)
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE chunk_vectors USING vec0(chunk_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, embedding float[1024])
CREATE TABLE "chunk_vectors_info" (key text primary key, value any)
CREATE TABLE "chunk_vectors_chunks"(chunk_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,size INTEGER NOT NULL,validity BLOB NOT NULL,rowids BLOB NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "chunk_vectors_rowids"(rowid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,chunk_id INTEGER,chunk_offset INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE "chunk_vectors_vector_chunks00"(rowid PRIMARY KEY,vectors BLOB NOT NULL)
